name: ShotClick: Screenplay & Script
original_description:
ShotClick is a screenplay editor that keeps what you write with ChatGPT in real screenplay format: scene headings, action, character cues, parentheticals and dialogue laid out to the industry standard, with scene numbers, revision passes, and PDF and Final Draft (.fdx) export.

With this plugin ChatGPT works inside your actual script instead of returning loose text in the chat. Ask it for a short film from an idea and it creates the project and writes the scenes straight into ShotClick. Ask it to rewrite a scene, tighten the dialogue or add a scene, and it reads the current version and saves the change in place, keeping scene numbers and formatting. It also reads and writes the subject, treatment and outline, sets scene loglines, keeps research notes, lists characters, searches the script and reads collaborators' comments. It can open a "what if" branch from any scene, so an alternate version of the story, such as a different ending, is written in parallel without touching the original. Every result links to the screenplay in the ShotClick editor, where the pages are already formatted and ready to export.

Connect it with your ShotClick account and the screenplays you write in ChatGPT are saved as projects in ShotClick, ready to edit, revise and export, with every scene number and revision pass in place.

Your existing permissions apply: on a shared project, a viewer stays read-only through the plugin too. No tool deletes anything (not a scene, not a project, not a note), and no tool spends ShotClick AI credits: the writing is done by ChatGPT.
summary_ja: 脚本形式でシーンの作成・編集や別案の管理を支援し、PDFやFinal Draft形式への書き出しを案内する。
limitations_ja: アプリ欄には接続にMCPコネクタを含むShotClickのStudioプランが必要と記載。既存権限が適用され閲覧者は読み取り専用、削除やShotClick AIクレジット消費は行わないと提供元は説明。実動作・料金は未検証。
